investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Redmark Software (collaboration SaaS); Platform: Microsoft Azure westeurope (zones westeurope-1/westeurope-2/westeurope-3); network range 10.107.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster redmar-prod-westeu (AKS); Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-02, maxmemory 12gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the webhooks-svc PostgreSQL database webhooks-db-01; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
